description: Passes one of its eight inputs to a single output, picking a different connected one at random every time a gate arrives

params.text: Sets how loudly the input that was selected before the last change is mixed in while it dies away, none at the far left and its full level at the far right

inputs.text: One of the eight signals the module chooses between; only a jack with a cable in it can be chosen
Picks a new input at random on each rising edge, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V
Adds to the FADE knob, 1V covering the whole of its travel

outputs.text: The input currently selected, with the fading tail of the one selected before it mixed in

notes: nothing reaches the output until at least one of the eight inputs has a cable in it
the green lamp beside an input is lit whenever that input has a cable, not when it is the one being passed, and the red lamp flashes each time the gate picks a new input
a polyphonic cable is passed through with all its channels, despite the maker's page calling these inputs monophonic

inputs.8:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.9:
0 to 1V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
